name: AppwinAnalytics
summary: Appwin Analytics SDK - screens, sessions, crash reporting, session replay.
description:
Analytics module of the Appwin SDK: screen views, sessions and installs,
crash and error reporting, and session replay. Your own events and the
consent go through AppwinCore (AppwinCore.track, AppwinCore.setConsent),
where the pipeline itself (persisted queue, batching, offline buffering)
lives.
